narrative.overview: The pill's speech bars, made huge and flat and laid across the headings and the pad photo at -7 degrees, over a modular grid of hard ink blocks on a cool grey ground. Loud, flat and Swiss, and light because people read it at a desk in daylight. The page proves the product by sound: real Kokoro speech drives the bars, and nothing plays until the visitor presses a voice.
keyCharacteristics: Cool grey, ink and white with three event colours

rules.name: Three colours, three meanings
rules.body: Teal is speech, blue is a question, yellow is an approval. No other saturated colour.

rules.name: One bar per heading
rules.body: Two multiplied bars crossing behind text make a near-black band.

rules.name: Lowercase voiceloop
rules.body: Always lowercase, bold in running text.

rules.name: Mono is for things you type
rules.body: Monospace only for commands, paths, ports and keys.

rules.name: Flat, with two real shadows
rules.body: Only the speech pill and the photo pins cast shadows.

dos: Make anything about voice playable, never autoplayed
Put one bar on each new section heading
Build groups as tiles on a 2px seam
Show the real pad, pill, speech and commands
donts: Don't add a fourth hue, gradients, glass or glow
Don't put a label above a heading
Don't round, border or shadow the blocks
Don't recolour the lockup or write VoiceLoop in copy
